data.name: Vampire Awakening: Elven Sword Chronicles Survival (吸血鬼的起床: 精灵幻剑录幸存者)
data.detailed_description:
================================
Game Introduction
================================

Blademaster Lyla went missing while investigating the forest anomaly.
You ventured into the forest in search of Laila.
You'll experience a small story through chapter after chapter of levels.
Defeat countless enemies in each chapter!

================================
Game Features
================================

  • Auto-attack weapon
  • Fast-paced, under 30 minutes per match.
  • 30 Chapters in Total
  • Supports LAN and Steam multiplayer.
  • Hundreds of items and weapons to discover, buy, and obtain.
  • Kill enemies to earn gold, buy items and weapons to power up.
  • Beast Spirit System, chance to obtain super powerful attributes.

================================
Game Mode
================================

  • Select a level and enter battle
  • Enemies will keep spawning. Defeat all incoming foes!
  • Defeat the final boss to clear the stage.

================================
Game Controls
================================

  • Arrow keys to move.
  • Action Keys: Z, X, C, V

================================
Difficulty-related, game difficulty varies across different levels.
================================

  • The game features 20 difficulty levels.
  • Strongly recommend playing only up to difficulty 10; difficulties 11 to 20 are extremely challenging.
  • If you have completed 30 levels and 10 difficulties, you have beaten the game.
  • If you complete 30 levels and 20 difficulties, you have conquered the challenge mode and finished the game.
1. Standard Difficulty
2.
Max Enemies: Base +5
Extra Lair Refresh: Level 1 Minion Nest
Elites and Bosses leap after dashing.
3.
Max Enemies: Base +15
Extra Lair Refresh: Spawns a Level 1 Elite Lair in the second wave.
Nest Boss gains new linear magic attack skill.
Elite monsters have stronger linear magic attacks.
Boss Minion
4.
Game map size doubled
Base Enemies: +15, then x1.25
Extra Lairs: two Level 1 Minion Lairs, one Level 2 Minion Lair, one Level 3 Minion Lair, one Level 1 Elite Lair.
Boss unleashes a continuous tracking magic beam attack.
Spawns an extra wave of minions with special behaviors.
5.
Extra Lairs: Three Tier 1 Elite Lairs, Three Tier 2 Elite Lairs
Minion respawn count doubled.
Elite monster spawn count doubled.
6.
Base Enemies +20, then x1.5
Double Enemy Spawns
Elites and Bosses knock back nearby enemies after jumping.
7.
Boss will switch to special magic bombardment skills.
8.
Gold mines spawn on the map. Attacking them has a 50% chance to grant 1 gold coin directly.
Red Crystals spawn on the map. Attacking them has a 0.5% chance to instantly grant 100 gold.
9.
Elite Jump Distance Increased
Elite's leap skill triggers a fan-shaped explosion upon landing.
10.
Game map size will continue to increase.
Boss HP increased to 120% of original.
11.
Linear Magic Bombardment, repels nearby enemies.
12.
Elite's Leap Shockwave
13.
Boss's Magic Bombardment knocks back nearby enemies.
Boss HP increased to 130% of original.
14.
When the second wave arrives, an additional batch of normal nests will spawn, doubling the total number.
Boss HP increased to 140% of original.
15.
Enemy attributes increased by 10%, now at 110% of original.
Attack Yellow Crystals for a 0.5% chance to gain 120 Gold instantly.
16.
Third wave spawns additional regular nests, tripling the total count.
Enemy attributes increased by 20%, now at 120% of original.
17.
Elite's leap slam unleashes a stronger扇形 explosion upon landing.
Amethyst crystals appear on the map. Attacking them has a 0.5% chance to instantly grant 200 gold.
18.
Straight Line Magic Attack skill of the Nest Boss becomes stronger.
Elite enemy's linear magic attack becomes stronger.
19.
Enhanced Dual-Tracking Linear Magic Attack
Enhanced dual-tracking magic missile from elite foes.
20.
Boss HP increased to 200% of original.
